newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares recover, Bourse indices at new highs.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares recover, Bourse indices at new highs.

text.p: Italian stocks recovered from a briefly lower opening on the back of Wall Street falls, with stock market indices surging to post new historic highs, dealers said.
* At 0826 GMT, the all-share Mibtel index was 0.63 percent up at 13,401 after an opening at 13,219.
* The Mib30 blue chip index was 0.85 percent higher at 20,409 after a 20,083 start.
Both indices had set previous highs on Monday.
* Italian June annual inflation rate seen falling to 1.4/1.5 percent from 1.6 percent in May, after last of 11 cities' data after close Monday underpinning optimistic tone.
* Energy group ENI, up 2.23 percent at 9,600 lire, on second day of this week's third tranche share offering which already seen as huge success, dealers said.
* In banks, buying interest continuing for Credito Italiano, up 1.09 percent at 3,250.
* Telecoms firm with Telecom Italia gaining 2.94 percent at 5,665 lire.
